strings.SGR_StateReich_close_pakt_desc: Click to hide decisions related to recreating the Einheitspakt.
strings.SGR_Regime_Collapse_Impeding_desc: The Führer's regime has lost too much of its standing - we must act quickly and restore some sense of stability to it! The Reactionaries are already setting their sights on the government - hurry!
strings.SGR_South_African_War_desc: Warfare has erupted in the dark bowels of Afrika, and the time has come to support our Reichskommissariats. To aid Schenck, Müller and Hüttig in the struggle against the South Africans and their supporters, we will send the necessary troops to bolster their ranks. Our advisors predict success in less than a year, after which we shall establish a loyal Boer puppet state under Albert Hertzog.
strings.SGR_South_African_War_Withdraw: Withdraw from the South African War
strings.SGR_South_African_War_Withdraw_desc: The situation in the South African War has not necessarily advantaged the Reich's position. Speer and his advisers have considered it prudent to withdraw our troops from this bloody conflict and let fate take its course.
strings.SGR_Ukraine_Question_desc: Ukraine must be dealt with as soon as possible. It is imperative that the political status of the 'Breadbasket of Europe' changes as part of our drive towards foreign policy reform.
strings.SGR_Netherlands_Question_desc: Our Germanic brethren in the Netherlands have torn themselves away from the security of the Reich, shockingly claiming their total independence despite Europe's cries of protestation. We will attempt to reintegrate the Dutch back into the Einheitspakt.
strings.SGR_Netherlands_Question_bypass_tt: With de Rochemont in power, negotiations are all but a formality for the re-entry of Reichskommissariat Niederlande to the Pakt.
strings.SGR_Denmark_Question_desc: The Germanization of our northern Protektorat has been under way for the last two decades. As well as the future of this nation in relation to the Reich, we must also address its changing political situation, and work towards integrating it back into the Einheitspakt.
strings.SGR_Bohemia_Question_desc: For over two decades, the economic and political situation in the German Reich has seen Bohemia and Moravia stand firmly to the side as a loyal Protektorat. The chaotic upheaval of the Bürgerkrieg has blasted the winds of change throughout much of Europe, and now the time has come to rethink its current status.
strings.SGR_Issue_of_Slovakia_desc: Having annexed the territory of Böhmen und Mähren, the Reich turns its monolithic gaze to the territory of Slovakia. Surrounded, with no friendly nations to back them up, and being simple to return back into the fold of the Pakt, we will issue them a concise ultimatum. They will either join, or we will smash open their pitiful army and march straight into Bratislava.
strings.SGR_Moskowien_Question_desc: The plains of blood and snow await our attention in the east. The disappearance of Siegfried Kasche has shifted the political landscape of Moskowien, a situation we must maintain absolute control over if the Reich's territories are to survive and thrive.
strings.SGR_Take_Moskowien_desc: The operation to retake Moskowien will be brutal. Trudging through what is essentially Europe's endless war field, the only silver lining remains in the fact that the country's shattering into many pieces has likewise shattered the morale of the civilians. There won't be many partisans left to oppose us, and we will mainly have to deal with whatever cobbled-up military might stand in our way. We should still be cautious, however, and not underestimate how difficult this may get.
strings.SGR_Moskowien_Setup_desc: With the long, empty territories of Moskowien finally back in our control, we must quickly re-organise it into a functional government. Alexis von Roenne will be instated as the official ruler of the country, and a military junta will be effectively established before we think about integrating it back into civilian control. They won't be happy, but they'll have to deal with it. It is better than whatever shattered Russian state could coax them into believing.
strings.SGR_Moskowien_Setup_tt: Moskowien will be put under new administration.
strings.SGR_Kaukasien_Question_desc: In the swirling dark fog of the Caucasus lies our most disconnected and mysterious Reichskommissariat. As a key producer of oil, this territory must be completely stabilized if it is to continue serving the interests of the Reich.
strings.SGR_Polish_Question_desc: History has clearly dictated that Poland must remain a sharp pain in Germany's side no matter the decade. With the Bürgerkrieg won, we must turn our attention eastwards and make a firm decision on how to deal with this thorn - once and for all.
strings.SGR_Norwegian_Question_desc: As the Bürgerkrieg raged on, Josef Terboven shocked the Reich by dismantling our northern Reichskommissariat and sending its garrison back to Germany. As of now, the new self-professed leader of Norway will receive our full attention, and we will plot how best to approach the future of this nation.
strings.SGR_Ostland_Question_desc: The so-called 'model colony' of the Reich, once a bastion of strength and loyalty, has been ravaged by internecine warfare and chaos. To ensure stability in our territories, we will shift our eyes eastwards and deal with Reichskommissariat Ostland.
strings.SGR_reinforce_mauritius_reunion_desc: Recent conflicts in the area have threatened our hold over the strategic outposts of Mauritius and Réunion - it is time to salvage this. A series of naval exercises shall be conducted in the Southwest Indian Ocean to reaffirm our presence. Like an eagle, the Kriegsmarine shall extend its wings and project its gaze far across the distant oceans of the world.
strings.SGR_place_nukes_mauritius_reunion: Place Nuclear Weapons in Mauritius and Réunion
strings.SGR_place_nukes_mauritius_reunion_desc: The Reich's swords cannot just lie in Europe, far from threatening our rivals. No, we must extend the reach of our nuclear weaponry to not only threaten their core lands, but to threaten their possessions nearby as well. The islands of Mauritius and Réunion lay as the first step in surrounding our enemies with global hellfire.
strings.SGR_allow_reunion_nukes: We have secured our position in Mauritius and Réunion.

To prevent the worst-case scenario, we must construct a massive defensive barrier along the border. While this will cost us immense sums of money, it will guarantee our security against the Russian threat.
